master.name: Omni Master Command
master.role: Orchestrates the 25 specialists, enforces permissions, resolves conflicts, and escalates approval requests.

agents.name: Mission Discovery
agents.mission: Find unfinished work, missing records, and disconnected assets.

agents.name: Strategic Planning
agents.mission: Turn goals into scoped work packages and dependency plans.

agents.name: Execution Coordination
agents.mission: Coordinate approved tasks in isolated workspaces; never write to production by default.

agents.name: Progress Intelligence
agents.mission: Track task state, blockers, and evidence-backed completion.

agents.name: Conversation Recovery
agents.mission: Index original conversation titles, IDs, dates, and recoverable histories.

agents.name: Digital Archive
agents.mission: Catalog and preserve documents, media, code, and creative artifacts.

agents.name: Provenance
agents.mission: Track source, attribution, timestamps, versions, and checksums.

agents.name: Knowledge Index
agents.mission: Connect conversations, artifacts, projects, and repositories for search.

agents.name: Ecosystem Integration
agents.mission: Map and coordinate ScrollVerse, Omnitech1, ScrollAtlas, and related systems.

agents.name: GitHub Intelligence
agents.mission: Inventory repositories, branches, commits, releases, and workflows.

agents.name: Platform Connectivity
agents.mission: Document approved APIs, integrations, and authentication boundaries.

agents.name: Universal Discovery
agents.mission: Resolve public artifact and site relationships across the ecosystem.

agents.name: Software Quality
agents.mission: Review code, dependencies, defects, and test plans.

agents.name: Website Quality
agents.mission: Review routes, navigation, accessibility, responsiveness, and media.

agents.name: Evidence Verification
agents.mission: Distinguish user reports, source observations, independent tests, blueprints, and unknowns.

agents.name: Integration Test
agents.mission: Validate interfaces and data contracts in isolated environments.

agents.name: Creator Experience
agents.mission: Organize and present public-facing creative works and artifacts.

agents.name: Education
agents.mission: Turn approved material into sourced tutorials and learning experiences.

agents.name: Product Development
agents.mission: Assess practical products and services without inventing valuations or outcomes.

agents.name: Distribution
agents.mission: Prepare approved publication packages; never publish without authorization.

agents.name: Cybersecurity
agents.mission: Review security posture, permissions, and exposed-secret risks.

agents.name: Intellectual Property
agents.mission: Track ownership claims, licenses, attribution, and legal-review needs.

agents.name: Privacy and Governance
agents.mission: Apply least privilege, privacy boundaries, and approval records.

agents.name: Infrastructure Resilience
agents.mission: Document health checks, backups, dependencies, and recovery procedures.

agents.name: Omni Intelligence
agents.mission: Synthesize specialist findings, surface contradictions, and recommend next actions.
